data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit other than **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES** is picked to **[Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** A **PLAGUE LEGIONS** unit of yours in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the enemy unit.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit in Engagement Range of the unit is picked to Fall Back, it takes a [Leadership test](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls), and must [Remain Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary) in that phase instead if it fails, for the rest of the phase.
